_reviewed_rules: c07 Завершение — Да: вопрос решён или передан с понятным следующим шагом, и оператор вежливо попрощался (повтор ответа перед прощанием тоже считается итогом). Нет: закрыл чат без прощания, попрощался при открытом вопросе или завершил отпиской. N/A: клиент ушёл или связь оборвалась до возможности завершить.
c02 Выявление потребности — N/A, если клиент сам сразу дал все данные, нужные для ответа (определение N/A из PDF: «данных хватало с самого начала»).

c02 N/A when the data was enough from the start, even if the operator re-asked something already known (that is a c06 slip). c02 Нет only when data was missing and the operator answered without asking.
c04 is scored by the final result: a wrong or vague first answer corrected in the same chat, with everything closed, is 20; the slip goes to c06.
c06: one slip (even if it made the client re-ask once) is 7; 4 only for two or more slips or repeated re-asks.
c07 Нет when the operator says goodbye while the question is still open, e.g. 'sent to check' with no timeline or way to get the result (consistent with c04 < 20 for the same reason).
c07 Нет for a bare informal farewell with no thanks or summary ('Bye.'), same logic as an informal greeting in c01. Standard polite one-word farewells stay Да.
Calls: if recording started after the operator's first line and the operator named the company and himself, a missing greeting word is not penalized (c01 Да).
c03 N/A when the operator only explains the general procedure and timing (e.g. a duplicate account can be deleted, call tomorrow) without naming anything from the account or doing an action on it.
Calls: Dastan may correct a label after listening to the audio; such cells are listed in audio_checked (the transcript misses them, so a text-only model is expected to differ).
_evidence_format: labels[id].criteria: organizers' format {criterion_id (contact/discovery/identification/consultation/empathy/dialogue/closure/critical), value (true/false/null = N/A/number), rationale (RU), evidence_turns (1-based, every line counted incl. bot/system = msg_index + 1)} + internal_id (c01..c08), name. 'answers' keeps the c01..c08 form used by npm run eval.
